options.label: The Topographic Survey Ledger
options.thesis: Observations mapped as surveyed benchmarks on an elevation grid, where the cryptographic hash-chain forms an unbroken survey traverse.
options.viewport: Crisp Android app screen with block #BLK-018 benchmark, observation plate with contour metadata, and verification seal.
options.risk: Requires restraint so contour grids feel like precision field gear rather than GIS clutter.
raised: ikebana: Active negative space discipline — zero decorative filler cards; the specimen photograph and cryptographic seal command the canvas.
hypercard: Tactile card structure — every observation is an indexable survey station with physical benchmark stamping.

options.label: The Field Expedition Pocketbook
options.lineage: waterproof field notebook & taxonomic voucher sheets
options.thesis: The indestructible field journal carried in tropical rainforest rain: waterproof graph paper, stamped taxonomic vouchers, and pencil-crisp data.
options.viewport: Field journal spread with grid backing, species photo voucher, tamper-evident hash ribbon, and observation notes.
options.risk: High familiarity; risks leaning into cozy analog notebook tropes if cryptographic rigor is downplayed.

options.label: Daylight & Habitat Strata
options.lineage: architectural daylight sections & canopy strata diagrams
options.thesis: Observations organized by diurnal light and forest canopy strata: floor, understory, canopy, and emergent layer.
options.viewport: Vertical habitat section with sightings pinned at their canopy layer and sun position.
options.case: Fuses habitat ecology directly into feed browsing; highly intuitive for biodiversity students.
options.risk: Can feel overly complex for casual street or backyard fauna sightings.

options.label: Ikebana Ma Alcove
options.case: Fuses poorly: wildlife documentation requires verifiable social evidence, not minimalist floral contemplation.

options.label: HyperCard Shoebox Stack
options.case: Fuses poorly: retro-computing 1-bit nostalgia clashes with modern cryptographic smartphone field journal.

canonCard.label: The Category Standard
canonCard.thesis: What social nature apps (iNaturalist + modern social timeline) ship, executed with clean typography and zero AI slop.
canonCard.viewport: Clean social feed card with author row, observation photo carousel, species tag, and like/comment row.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from conventional social apps by design.
